name: Terminal File Manager (TUI)
shortDesc: Keyboard-driven file manager inside your terminal with instant image previews.
detailedDesc: Navigate directories at the speed of thought without touching your mouse.

phase.title: Daily Apps & Productivity
phase.description: Web browsers, terminals, file managers (GUI and TUI), media viewers, notes, and local file sharing.

packages.name: Yazi (Recommended)
packages.description: Blazingly fast terminal file manager written in Rust with asynchronous I/O and direct GPU image preview rendering.
pros: Direct Kitty/Sixel graphics protocol image previews
cons: Requires terminal emulator supporting image protocols for graphics previews

packages.name: Superfile
packages.description: Modern, gorgeous terminal file manager with rich file icons and multi-panel navigation.

packages.name: lf (List Files)
packages.description: Lightweight terminal file manager inspired by ranger, written in Go with single-binary efficiency.
cons: Requires shell scripting for preview generators
